items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: Only Roy stuck it out, and that's because of Norman Granz.

ctx.x: Yeah, there were certain clubs in certain big cities.

Right. So what happens between, you know, and we weren't making that much money when we were playing there either. People like Hawk and Edmond Hall and Perez, they died from desperation, like what's the use, you know? They were contributing all along. Couldn't get anywhere. Only Roy stuck it out, and that's because of Norman Granz. (nonsense) Norman Granz saved the situation. He changed that around, as far as engagements go, hiring guys.
